Lead the research, design, and analytical writing for the upcoming Marine Corps Force Design blueprint, translating high-level national military strategies into viable organizational structures.
Conduct exhaustive, service-wide quantitative and qualitative force structure analyses of current Marine Corps capabilities, manning documents (T/O&E), and operational alignments.
Evaluate the DOTMLPF-P (Doctrine, Organization, Training, Materiel, Leadership, Personnel, Facilities, Policy) second- and third-order effects of proposed force design changes to advise senior leadership on resource constraints and organizational turbulence.
Organize, integrate, and lead collaborative planning teams and working groups comprised of military officers, civilian analysts, and academic specialists to solve complex force management and integration challenges.
Review strategic documents, conduct independent research on global security trends, and communicate findings with external partners at the TS/SCI, SAP, CAP, STO, and ACCM levels across all warfighting functional areas.
Support the development of executive-level briefs, reports, and investment recommendations regarding future capabilities and force generation modeling.

Minimum Qualifications

Master’s degree and at least five (5) years of experience in force management, force development, or strategic defense planning. A bachelor’s degree and (10) years of directly related experience will be accepted in lieu of a Master's degree.
At least fifteen (15) years of professional military or defense-related experience, with a significant background operating in high-level staff assignments (e.g., Service Headquarters, Major Command G-3/5/8, Joint Staff, or Combatant Commands).
Extensive background in organizational design, capabilities-based assessments (CBAs), or force integration processes, demonstrating a professional background similar to an Army FA-50 Force Management functional area officer.
Demonstrated professional experience conducting in-depth research, synthesizing complex raw data (manpower, equipment, and readiness), and executing structured analytic techniques to produce senior-level decision products.
Proven capability to think critically, analyze complex/abstract operational concepts, and write clear, concise strategic documents under minimal guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

In-depth, practical knowledge of current United States Marine Corps force structure, Marine Air-Ground Task Force (MAGTF) doctrine, and the ongoing "Force Design" modernization initiative.

Physical Requirements

jobs.title: Lead Product Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Role

Hippocratic AI is looking for a Lead Product Data Analyst to shape product strategy and measure the clinical, operational, and financial impact of our healthcare AI products. This isn't a dashboarding role — you'll help define what "good" looks like for AI clinical agents (including critic frameworks and quality criteria), not just track adoption of a finished product.

You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, clinical teams, and leadership to answer questions like: What should we build? What's driving or limiting adoption? What outcomes are we creating for patients and customers? Where should we invest next — and how do we prove it with data?

The ideal candidate moves comfortably from an ambiguous business question to structured analysis to an executive-ready recommendation, and has the business judgment to know which questions matter most.

What You'll Do

Define how we measure success

Partner with clinical and product teams to define AI agent performance criteria, including critic frameworks and quality metrics.
Define north star metrics and measurement frameworks that guide product strategy — not just measure what already exists.
Design analytical approaches to evaluate product changes and program impact, including in real-world settings where randomized experiments aren't possible.
Conduct pre- and post-launch analysis to determine whether initiatives achieved their intended outcomes.

Turn data into decisions and dollars

Translate ambiguous product and business questions into structured analysis and clear recommendations that influence roadmap and prioritization.
Build business cases and ROI models connecting product usage to operational efficiency, cost reduction, capacity, and patient/customer outcomes.
Partner with technical teams to improve instrumentation so the data behind these decisions is reliable.

Represent the work — internally and with customers

Present findings and recommendations (not just metrics) to Product leadership and executives.
Sit directly in customer and partner conversations to represent product data, outcomes, and ROI — this isn't just internal deck prep.
Serve as a strategic analytics partner across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and GTM, and help raise the analytical bar as we scale.

Location Requirement

We believe the best ideas happen together. To support fast collaboration and a strong team culture, this role is expected to be in our Menlo Park office five days a week, unless otherwise specified.

What You Bring

Must-have

5+ years in product analytics, product strategy, data analytics, business strategy, or management consulting.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical discipline (Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Data Science, CS, Engineering, or related).
Advanced SQL and demonstrated ability to independently analyze large, complex datasets; working Python proficiency preferred.
Demonstrated experience using data to influence product strategy, prioritization, or roadmap decisions.
Experience with product analytics/BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, or similar).
Design analytical approaches to evaluate product changes and program impact — including in real-world settings where randomized experiments aren't possible.
Experience building business cases, ROI analyses, or financial models, and presenting them to senior stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have

Experience in product analytics or strategy at a technology, healthcare technology, SaaS, or AI company.
Experience working with healthcare data, products, clinical workflows, or healthcare organizations.
Fluency in healthcare financial and value-based care concepts (e.g., HRRP/readmission economics, value-based care arrangements, risk-based contracting).

As a Principal Sensory Scientist, you will serve as a senior scientific expert helping shape how Sam’s Club evaluates and improves products across merchandise categories. By translating member experiences into actionable insights, the team supports Product Development, Merchandising, and supplier partners. jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Amazon Connect
jobs.description:
Description

This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). The Amazon Connect Customer Success (CSS) team is responsible for driving post-sales success for Amazon Connect customers through strategic engagement on migrations, expansions, and AI adoption initiatives. This Senior Technical Program Manager role owns the end-to-end reporting, tooling, and operational program management function for the Connect CSS team.

The Senior TPM is the dedicated owner of all reporting cadences, business intelligence mechanisms, and program tracking infrastructure that enables the CSS leadership team and stakeholders to make data-driven decisions. This is a highly operational role that requires both business and technical acumen: you will build and improve the processes, tools, and mechanisms that underpin the team's ability to measure impact, communicate progress, and drive accountability across a globally distributed customer success organization.

You will manage the lifecycle of a complex, cross-functional program with considerable impact, working within and across VP-level organizations. You are accountable for program strategy, defining and driving improvements quantified with metrics, and influencing resource allocation and priorities across partner teams including Sales Operations and the Customer Success Center of Excellence (CS COE).

Key job responsibilities

Reporting and Business Intelligence

Own end-to-end delivery of all recurring reporting cadences for the Connect CSS team (weekly status updates, WBR, MBR, and QBR), producing the executive summaries and dashboards that give leadership clear, accurate, actionable insight into team performance, customer health, revenue impact, and goal attainment.
Own revenue realization tracking, partnering with Finance and Service teams on account identification, coverage attribution, and post-sale attainment.
Define and maintain data collection processes so CSS members provide timely, accurate inputs (migration and expansion status, customer insights, AI adoption metrics) that feed consolidated reporting.

Tooling and Process Improvement

Own the CSS reporting and tooling strategy, including the evaluation, adoption, and optimization of tools such as Asana, BI dashboards, internal reporting portals, and geographic review dashboards.
Serve as the primary CSS interlock with Sales Operations and central customer success operations, defining Connect CSS requirements for centralized tooling, dashboards, and post-launch tracking, and holding partner teams accountable to agreed roadmaps.
Continuously streamline, automate, or eliminate manual reporting to reduce operational burden while improving data quality and timeliness.

Program and Project Management

Maintain program tracking for CSS goals, pillars, projects, and strategic initiatives in Asana, giving leadership visibility into progress, risks, and dependencies without their chasing information.
Coordinate cross-functional dependencies across Sales Operations, central customer success operations, the Connect Service Team, and Specialist Sales leadership on reporting requirements, data definitions, and timelines.
Manage escalation paths for data discrepancies, tooling gaps, and process breakdowns, driving crisp resolution and escalating effectively when needed.

Strategic Contribution

Contribute to the CSS team's annual operational planning, including goal-setting frameworks, capacity planning inputs, and mechanism design.
Partner with CSS leadership to evolve the reporting and tooling function as business needs, product launches, and organizational growth demand, advocating for scalable mechanisms over one-off manual solutions.

A day in the life

As the Senior TPM for Connect CSS, you operate at the intersection of business operations and technical tooling. In a given week, you might be finalizing the weekly status update for distribution to leadership and stakeholders, reviewing business review data for accuracy and completeness, running a requirements session with central operations partners on dashboard enhancements, and updating the Asana project board to reflect current project status across the team's strategic pillars.

You are the person the team depends on to make sure reporting is accurate, timely, and tells a clear story. When a new reporting requirement emerges (e.g., revenue realization tracking, a new quarterly review format requested by leadership), you define how the CSS team will collect the data, where it will be stored, and how it will be presented. You coordinate across Sales Operations and central operations teams to align on definitions and ensure CSS needs are represented in centralized tools.

You are always looking for ways to improve. You notice when a manual weekly process could be replaced by an automated dashboard. You push for tooling enhancements that reduce the number of places team members need to update information. You build mechanisms that ensure reporting quality without requiring heroics from individual contributors.

About The Team

Amazon Connect is a cloud-based contact center service that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. Built on the same technology that powers Amazon's own award-winning customer service at massive scale, Amazon Connect leverages artificial intelligence, machine learning, and the broad AWS ecosystem to transform how organizations interact with their customers.

The Connect Customer Success team sits within the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization and is chartered to accelerate customer outcomes across the Amazon Connect installed base. The team drives migrations from legacy on-premises platforms to Amazon Connect, supports expansion of existing deployments, and leads adoption of AI-powered capabilities such as Amazon Connect agent assist, conversational analytics, and generative AI capabilities. The CSS team operates globally across the Americas, EMEA, and APJ, working in close partnership with Specialist Sales, Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, and the Amazon Connect Service Team.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience developing operational processes and technologies
Experience demonstrating strong analytical abilities and confidence in the use of data

Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

jobs.description:
About XCures

Lots of data, little understanding. Medical records for a single patient live scattered across dozens of providers, and critical data is buried in unstructured faxes, PDFs, and notes that no one has time to read. Access to health data is no longer the problem. Getting a clear, structured, trusted piece of information out of that mess is. That’s the problem xCures® exists to solve.

The xCures Clinical Clarity Engine turns fragmented records into validated, source-linked answers built for the next decision. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from. Automatically get the patient history you need, so you can make decisions based on more accurate information without digging through documents.

Our mission: “To find and organize all healthcare data, empowering insights that improve care for everyone.”

We work with anyone that needs information from medical data for their next decision: diagnostic labs, providers, telehealth providers, health systems, payers, consumer health platforms, and more. Wherever a decision is stuck behind 200 scattered documents no one has time to read, that’s our problem to solve. We’re a remote-first, Series B, venture-backed team that holds itself to the same standard as our product: trustworthy, precise, and purposeful. If you like solving problems that are genuinely hard and useful, you’ll feel at home here.

Here’s Where You’ll Make An Impact

At xCures, clinical data curation is defined cross-functionally between product and technical teams. This role owns the layer beside it: the operational and transactional data generated when internal and external customers interact with our platform. You’ll turn that activity into governed, well-defined, trusted information the business runs on.

Reporting to the Strategic Program Manager, you'll own the data glossary and governance layer end to end as a senior individual contributor. If you want a seat where you set the standards rather than inherit them, and where your work is the reason every downstream team can trust its numbers, this is it.

Key Responsibilities

Own the enterprise data glossary and business definitions, keeping them aligned with the curation scope set by the core product team
Establish and maintain data governance policies, quality controls, and business-rule validation rules, including so downstream data stays trustworthy and consistent across every consumer
Determine which datasets are fit for use and enforce one source of truth, so every team analyzes from the same core tables
Map and document business data lineage from the product data layer to each stakeholder function, showing what each field means downstream and where it originates
Serve as the analytics partner across the business, translating their data needs into governed, reusable definitions and reporting
Train and support business users on accessing, interpreting, and using approved datasets and dashboards (e.g., revenue and financial data mappings), serving as the bridge between technical data teams and business stakeholders
Investigate data anomalies and historical gaps, own the escalation path for data quality issues to the appropriate technical owner, and build structural controls that prevent them from recurring
Support external-facing data consumers with governed, well-documented definitions they can trust
Partner with the product team and the Senior Director, Informatics on changes to the underlying data model, assessing downstream impact on business definitions and reporting before rollout

Qualifications

Required:

5+ years, or equivalent depth owning a data governance or BI function
Proven track record building and maintaining data glossaries, business definitions, and metadata documentation
Strong SQL and hands-on experience with modern BI and reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
Demonstrated ability to partner across functions (such as finance, sales, revenue operations, customer success, data science, medical affairs) and translate their needs into governed, reusable data
Able to make complex data understandable to non-technical stakeholders, in writing and verbally
Comfort operating independently, owning a function end to end, and driving adoption across teams without direct reports

Bonus Points

Experience in healthcare data or another regulated data environment
Familiarity with data modeling and transformation tooling (e.g. dbt, Dataform, or similar)
Exposure to external-facing or customer-delivered data products

Location

xCures operates in a distributed, remote-first environment, with occasional travel to company offsites or key meetings throughout the year. Candidates may be located anywhere in the United States. The successful candidate must already have authorization to work in the United States. At this time, xCures does not offer sponsorship. All candidate information will be held in confidence and in accordance with EEOC guidelines.

Additional Considerations

We recognize that people bring a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the requirements listed in a job description. Diversity of experience and skills, combined with a shared passion for healthcare, is what drives us to innovate. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. xCures is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Benefits

Great work deserves great support. We believe our people are our greatest asset, and we’re committed to supporting them with a strong, competitive benefits package. Our goal is to be a place where people genuinely want to build their careers, and our benefits are designed to support our team in the ways that matter most.

And more!

jobs.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

Most TPM roles focus on tracking timelines, coordinating milestones, and driving execution against an established plan. This role is different. You’ll own the operational backbone of a vision AI data program, ensuring ideas move seamlessly from hypothesis to data capture to validation to a governed dataset to a commercial product.

You’ll sit at the center of a complex ecosystem spanning a lean founding engineering team, capture hardware and annotation vendors, frontier AI and robotics companies, academic partners, and internal Legal, Site Operations, and Finance teams. Your mandate is to create operational continuity across these interfaces, remove friction, accelerate decisions, and maintain a disciplined path from experimentation to validated, production ready outcomes.

Stord Labs is an innovation center designed to evaluate emerging logistics technologies and help redefine the future of fulfillment. Within a live micro fulfillment environment, you’ll orchestrate the full lifecycle of technical experiments, ensuring promising concepts are rigorously tested, clearly validated, and efficiently transitioned into production when they demonstrate measurable business value.

This role is built for a systems oriented program leader who has operated in computer vision, ML, AI, robotics, or data intensive environments and can translate fluently between research, engineering, and warehouse operations without sacrificing speed or precision. You’ll be equally comfortable working with engineers and researchers, coordinating external partners, navigating operational constraints, and communicating outcomes to executive stakeholders.

The goal isn’t simply to manage the program. It’s to build the operating system that allows a new vision AI capability to move from idea to validated data product at scale.

What You'll Do

Own the evaluation lifecycle: Govern the end to end pipeline of experiments, ensuring every initiative starts with a clear hypothesis, measurable success criteria, and structured evaluation framework. Drive disciplined decisions to kill, iterate, or scale based on evidence.
Run hardware and vendor evaluations: Lead structured, evidence based evaluations across capture devices, depth sensors, gloves, edge compute, and data and annotation vendors. Own RFPs, scorecards, evaluation frameworks, and vendor selection.
Orchestrate the cross functional ecosystem: Serve as the primary integration point between the engineering pod and Legal, Site Operations, Finance, and warehouse operations. Coordinate requirements around consent, associate participation, scheduling, floor logistics, cost modeling, and operational readiness.
Manage the data pipeline program: Drive the path from pilot capture through annotation, validation, and secure buyer delivery. Own annotation throughput and QA cadence while establishing and tracking data quality, capture yield, and delivery metrics.
Manage partners and buyers: Coordinate technical and operational engagement with frontier AI and robotics companies and academic partners such as Georgia Tech. Translate customer requirements into clear program priorities and ensure datasets meet the standards required for validation and delivery.
Keep governance and risk on track: Ensure consent, privacy, and data rights requirements are addressed with Legal before and throughout capture activities. Identify and retire program risks while keeping executive sponsors informed of progress, tradeoffs, and decisions.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related technical discipline.
8+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Engineering Management, or complex cross functional delivery roles.
Demonstrated experience running computer vision, ML, or data pipeline programs end to end, including data collection, annotation, model training pipelines, or data platform delivery.
Proven experience managing both hardware and data or annotation vendors, including RFPs, structured evaluations, scorecards, and strategic partnerships.
Comfortable operating in deeply technical CV, ML, and data environments and translating between research, engineering, and operations without losing precision.
Strong execution discipline and experience operating in agile, sprint based, or similar environments.
Demonstrated judgment in making and driving kill, iterate, or scale decisions based on data and outcomes.
High ownership and comfort operating in ambiguous, 0 to 1 environments.

Bonus Points

Experience in innovation labs, R&D environments, or advanced automation programs.
Familiarity with egocentric or robotics datasets, annotation platforms such as Scale, MLOps, or delivering datasets to external customers.
Experience with data governance, privacy, or consent programs, including BIPA, GDPR, or CCPA requirements.
Familiarity with warehouse data ecosystems and architectures, including WMS, OMS, WES, and WCS.
Exposure to digital twin or simulation initiatives.
Domain knowledge in warehouse automation, robotics integration, or fulfillment operations.
Experience working with frontier AI companies, robotics companies, academic research institutions, or other emerging technology partners.

This position is located in the District Department of Transportation (DDOT), Infrastructure Project Management Administration (IPMA), Citywide Engineering and Special Projects Division, Anacostia Waterfront Initiative Branch. Reporting to the Deputy Chief Engineer, Citywide Engineering & Special Projects Division, the Project Manager is responsible for delivering a portfolio of engineering, standards, procurement, environmental, legal, financial, right-of-way, utilities, and construction activities.

The Project Manager shall have a background in delivering complex or high-profile capital infrastructure projects through various phases of planning, feasibility, environmental, design, legal, right-of-way, utilities, and construction to ensure they follow local and federal laws and standards, which may involve coordination with other District agencies, the Executive Office of the Mayor, Council offices and Advisory Neighborhood Commissions, and federal agencies. Job Summary

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance)
is responsible for protecting the organization's information assets, technology infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, data, and artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives from cyber threats and misuse. This role serves as a key contributor to both cybersecurity operations and AI governance programs by identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks associated with Information Systems as well as AI-enabled technologies.

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance)
works closely with IT teams, software developers, business stakeholders, and external partners to ensure cybersecurity and AI initiatives align with security policies, industry standards, regulatory requirements, and emerging AI governance frameworks. This position will work closely with the CIO and CISO functions to provide a cohesive plan for cybersecurity initiatives, AI governance, Shadow AI oversight, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Compensation

[Starting / Initial] Base Salary Pay Range: $100,000/yr - $120,000/yr

Specific offers within the listed pay ranges are determined by a variety of factors such as experience, education, skills, certifications and business needs.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Monitor security systems, networks, applications, cloud platforms, and AI-enabled services for suspicious activity and potential threats.
Analyze security alerts and investigate cybersecurity incidents to determine root causes and appropriate remediation actions.
Support incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
Conduct vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation efforts with technical and business stakeholders.
Review and analyze security logs from various sources, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, endpoint protection platforms, cloud environments, identity providers, AI platforms, and other security technologies.

Assist with audits, compliance reviews, AI governance assessments, and regulatory reporting requirements.
Research emerging cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, cybersecurity trends, AI technologies, and industry best practices and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies/countermeasures.

Microsoft (MS) Excel, Word, Project, Planner, Power BI, Teams, Power Apps.

Work with all stakeholders to ensure governance frameworks and continuous improvement or transformation plans are established and maintained

Develop business insights through analysis of results and communicate key findings to management to support data-driven decision-making
Secure appropriate resources and personnel in collaboration with management to ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget
Escalate barriers, risks, and issues that may impact timelines or deliverables in a timely and appropriate manner
Manage the development of polished executive-level presentations and deliver findings to internal associates and external clients clearly and concisely

jobs.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way. Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward. We are looking for an IFM Small Works Project Delivery Manager for our Integrated Facility Management business line.

About JLL

We're JLL. We're a professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We help organizations around the world achieve their ambitions by owning, occupying and investing in real estate. If you're looking to step up your career, JLL is the perfect professional home. At JLL, you'll have a chance to innovate with the world's leading businesses, put that expertise into action on landmark projects, and work on game-changing real estate initiatives. You'll also make long-lasting professional connections through sharing different perspectives, and you'll be inspired by the best. We're focused on opportunity and want to help you make the most of yours. Achieve your ambitions – join us at JLL!

Role Purpose

We are seeking an experienced Project Delivery Manager to join the EMEA Small Works Program within the Engineering function. This role operates as a governance and subject matter expert (SME) resource, providing structured support to IFM teams across EMEA in the delivery of small-scale capital projects — including building retrofits, refurbishments, workspace reconfigurations, and targeted facility improvements. This is not a traditional end-to-end project management role. The primary function is to enable local FM teams to deliver projects compliantly, safely, and frugally by providing governance oversight, procurement guidance, technical SME support, and structured project frameworks. Direct end-to-end project delivery will only apply in cases deemed critical, high-visibility, or where project complexity requires dedicated program-level management. The role sits within the EMEA Small Works Program and operates across a tiered delivery model: Reports to - EMEA Small Works Program Lead (Engineering).

Governance & Compliance Oversight

Provide governance support to FM teams delivering Tier 2 projects, ensuring adherence to the Small Works framework, CAPEX governance processes, and client standards.
Support the triage process to ensure projects are correctly categorized within the tiered model and appropriately resourced.
Ensure EHS, legislative, and legal compliance requirements are actively governed across all supported projects, spanning multiple EMEA jurisdictions.
Monitor compliance with CDM regulations (where applicable), building regulations, health and safety requirements, and client-specific standards.
Ensure workspace design standards and regulatory requirements are maintained throughout project delivery.

SME Support & FM Team Enablement

Act as a subject matter expert resource for FM teams managing Tier 2 projects — providing guidance on project methodology, sequencing, risk management, and technical approach.
Provide procurement guidance to FM teams, ensuring competitive quotations are obtained from approved contractors and that works are delivered frugally within scope.
Coordinate SME input where specialist technical knowledge is required (mechanical, electrical, building fabric, sustainability).
Coach and support FM teams on the application of Small Works tools, templates, and governance standards for Tier 1 delivery.
Act as an escalation point for FM teams encountering project challenges, scope changes, or compliance queries.

Project Triage & Categorization

Support the Small Works Program Lead in operating the triage process — assessing incoming project requests against complexity criteria to determine appropriate tier allocation.
Identify projects at risk of scope misclassification and ensure early intervention to prevent cost overruns or delivery failures.
Recommend escalation to WD&C where project complexity exceeds Small Works scope.

Financial Oversight & Procurement Guidance

Provide financial governance support for Tier 2 projects (typically sub-€150K), ensuring budgets are realistic, tracked, and reported.
Guide FM teams on procurement processes, contractor selection, and cost control within approved frameworks.
Review and advise on variations, cost changes, and final accounts where FM teams require support.
Contribute to CAPEX forecasting and budget reporting for the Small Works portfolio within assigned geographic areas.

Direct Project Delivery (Critical/High-Visibility Only)

Manage end-to-end delivery of projects designated as critical, high-visibility, or requiring dedicated program-level oversight.
Ensure these projects are completed on time, within budget, and to specification while minimizing disruption to building occupants.
Maintain comprehensive project records including correspondence, RFIs, site instructions, progress reports, and as-built documentation for directly managed projects.

Stakeholder Management & Coordination

Serve as a key interface between FM teams, the Small Works Program, WD&C, and client stakeholders for Tier 2 projects.
Coordinate with WD&C on project handoffs, triage decisions, and boundary management between projects.
Communicate project progress, risks, and governance status to the Small Works Program Lead and wider stakeholders.
Build effective working relationships with FM teams across assigned geographic areas to ensure the program is embedded and trusted.

Program Tools, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Maintain and update the IFM Project Tracker for assigned projects and geographic areas.
Utilize and promote standardized Small Works templates, tools, and reporting mechanisms.
Report on program KPIs including speed of delivery, cost efficiency, safety and compliance, and quality consistency.
Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in governance processes, tools, and FM team support mechanisms.
Contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of the Small Works framework.

Sound Like You? To Apply You Need to Have Essential Qualifications & Experience

Degree in Construction Management, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
Minimum 3–5 years' experience in construction project management, building refurbishment, or facilities management — with demonstrable experience in governance, compliance oversight, or program support functions.
Experience supporting or enabling operational teams in the delivery of projects (not solely direct delivery experience).
Understanding of building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and building fabric.
Knowledge of building regulations, EHS requirements, and compliance frameworks across multiple jurisdictions.
Familiarity with CDM regulations and construction health and safety practices.
Experience with procurement processes, contractor management, and cost control.
Experience operating within a structured program or portfolio environment.

Essential Skills

Strong governance mindset — ability to apply frameworks consistently while remaining pragmatic.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, particularly in enabling and influencing teams without direct authority.
Proficient in project planning, budgeting, and cost control.
Strong organizational skills with ability to oversee multiple concurrent projects across different sites and countries.
Problem-solving mindset with a coaching and enablement approach.
Competent using MS Office, project management software, and digital collaboration tools.
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to compliance and quality.

What You Can Expect From Us

You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things. Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, wellbeing, benefits and pay. We’ll offer you a competitive salary and benefits package. Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sights and imagine where JLL can take you…

jobs.description:
Build your future with Sovos.

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionising how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do

We are looking for an Enterprise Project Manager to join our European Professional Services team, with the ability to be based in the United Kingdom, Netherlands, or Spain. This is a senior delivery role for an experienced PM who understands the complexity of enterprise SaaS implementations — and who brings deep familiarity with tax compliance, e-invoicing, or regulatory technology.

You will own end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-country e-invoicing and tax compliance implementations for enterprise clients across the EMEA region. You will be the client's primary delivery partner — managing scope, timeline, risk, and stakeholder relationships from kickoff through go-live and Hypercare. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, and your work will directly impact client satisfaction, revenue recognition, and the reputation of Sovos Professional Services in Europe.

More Specifically, You Will

Own end-to-end project delivery for enterprise e-invoicing and tax compliance implementations across multiple EMEA countries simultaneously
Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation for client stakeholders — from project teams to C-suite sponsors — throughout the engagement lifecycle
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, risk registers, issue logs, and status reports; proactively surface risks and drive resolution before they become escalations
Lead structured project governance — including weekly status meetings, monthly steering committee sessions, and go/no-go decision processes — in alignment with Sovos delivery methodology
Manage project scope rigorously; identify, document, and drive change orders when client requests exceed agreed SOW boundaries
Coordinate cross-functional Sovos resources — Solution Consultants, Technical Consultants, SAP specialists, Regulatory, and Product — to deliver against project commitments
Track and report project hours against PS retainer balances; proactively communicate burn-down status and initiate retainer expansion conversations at appropriate thresholds
Ensure all project data, time entries, and status records are accurately maintained in Cloud Coach and Sovos project management tooling in real time
Manage Hypercare periods post-go-live and execute formal project handover to Sovos Customer Support
Contribute to the continuous improvement of PS delivery methodology, SOW templates, onboarding playbooks, and project governance frameworks
Provide structured feedback to Product Management on implementation patterns, recurring defects, and enhancement opportunities observed across the client portfolio

What We Need From You

7+ years of project management experience, with at least 4 years delivering enterprise SaaS implementations in a client-facing Professional Services environment
Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder implementations in the tax compliance, e-invoicing, VAT, or regulatory technology space — this is a differentiating requirement
Proven track record managing projects with enterprise clients (500M+ revenue) across multiple countries and time zones concurrently
Experience with SAP-integrated implementations (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, or Process Orchestration) is strongly preferred
Hands-on experience with retainer-based PS engagements, including scope management, change order discipline, and hour burn-down governance
Familiarity with EMEA e-invoicing mandates — including France (PPF/PDP), Germany (XRechnung/Peppol), Poland (KSeF), and/or Turkey (e-Fatura/e-Arşiv) — is a significant advantage
Exceptional stakeholder management — able to build trust with client executives and navigate competing priorities without losing delivery momentum
Strong commercial acumen — understands the relationship between project delivery, revenue recognition, and margin, and manages accordingly
Proactive risk management mindset — identifies and escalates issues early, documents decisions, and drives accountability without being asked
Clear, structured communicator — written and verbal — capable of adapting tone and detail level for technical teams, client project managers, and executive sponsors alike
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving clarity in fast-moving, multi-mandate environments where priorities can shift quickly
Proficiency with project management tooling (e.g. Cloud Coach, Salesforce, Jira, or equivalent PSA/CRM platforms
PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification preferred
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field; equivalent experience considered
Fluency in English required; proficiency in French, German, Dutch, Spanish, or Polish is a meaningful advantage given the client base

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

An opportunity to work with a global team
Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
Mentoring Programs
Globally recognised Training and Development programs
Benefits

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

About The Role

As our IT Technical Project Manager
, you’ll take ownership of the end-to-end delivery of complex technology projects across IT Desktop, Networking and Business Systems.

Working with business sponsors, system owners, technical specialists and third-party suppliers, you’ll translate approved business requirements and technical solutions into clear, controlled delivery plans. You’ll lead projects from initiation and planning through testing, implementation, hypercare, closure and successful handover into business-as-usual support.

You’ll manage project governance, budgets, forecasts, risks, dependencies and change control, while ensuring stakeholders have clear and transparent visibility of progress. You’ll also oversee suppliers, testing, implementation and operational readiness, making sure projects are delivered safely, securely, on time and within budget.

This is a highly collaborative role where you’ll lead cross-functional and multi-supplier teams, constructively challenge technical plans and assumptions, and ensure new or changed technology services are ready to operate effectively from day one.

About You

We’re looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager
with a strong track record of successfully delivering complex technology projects with significant operational, financial or client impact.

You’ll bring experience across areas such as end-user computing, infrastructure, networks, cloud services, cybersecurity, business applications, systems integration or data migration, together with the technical confidence to challenge architects, engineers, application specialists and suppliers when needed.

You’ll be comfortable managing the full project lifecycle, including planning, governance, budgets, risks, testing, deployment, hypercare and operational handover. Commercially aware and highly organised, you’ll also have experience managing third-party suppliers, contractual deliverables and competing priorities.

Strong stakeholder management is essential. You’ll be confident engaging and influencing at all levels, including having robust conversations with senior leaders, clients and third parties. You’ll be analytical, resilient and proactive, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to manage multiple complex priorities.

Experience of recognised delivery approaches such as PRINCE2, Agile or Kanban
is expected, while relevant professional qualifications such as Risk Management or Six Sigma would be advantageous. Above all, you’ll share Atlas’ purpose and values and bring a practical, accountable approach to delivering change.

Full learning &s support from Atlas.

Atlas continues to grow at pace which is both exciting and challenging.

Who are we?

Atlas is a family of people drawn together by a passion for creating happiness in others.

Founded in 1986 and 100% owned by our employees, we are now one of the fastest-growing business support companies in the UK, providing cleaning, security, pest and other support services to a wide range of companies, from globally recognised brands to small local businesses. Our success is down to one thing; the passion and commitment of our extended family, who together we deliver happiness across thousands of client sites every single day. To ensure we remain focused on our purpose as we grow, we recruit first and foremost on our values so for those committed to living them alongside us, there is no better place to work.

Our Purpose

To create happiness in ourselves and others

We approach work and life with a sense of fun, optimism and belief, and strive to have a positive impact on the world around us. We show kindness and compassion to all those we meet, ensuring everyone is safe and healthy. We deliver on our promises and go the extra mile every day.

Our Values

We are a family

Just like any other family, we laugh, cry, celebrate and commiserate together. We may come from many different backgrounds, but we’re always there when it really matters. Whether it’s with practical help and support, or simply a mug of tea and a shoulder to cry on.

Sharing makes us stronger

Knowledge is more powerful when its shared. Which is why we share everything - our ideas, our expertise, our news and most-of-all our time. Show humility. Share and work together, and anything is possible.

Own your space

You are Atlas. Don’t be afraid to make decisions. Use your time wisely and treat every pound as if it was coming from your own pocket.

Be honest. Always.

Have the courage to do the right thing, even when no-one is watching. Whether it’s owning up to a mistake, having a difficult conversation, or simply arguing a point you feel passionate about. Be yourself. Authenticity breeds trust. Trust brings happiness.

Don't just talk. Do.

We are a business that thrives on doing. The more we do, the more we succeed. Embrace change. Keep it simple. Keep meetings short. Plan just enough to succeed. And then get on with it.

Technical Delivery & Implementation Management

Dual-Vendor Governance & Coordination

Risk, Dependency & Change Management

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are currently recruiting for Senior Project Managers to take ownership of key project portfolios and lead the successful delivery of major infrastructure programmes that impact millions of lives.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will have end-to-end accountability for complex, high-value projects. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, you’ll manage EPC contracts, drive strong project performance, and ensure robust governance alongside the highest standards of health, safety, and environmental management. You will play a critical role in delivering against our regulatory, stakeholder, and customer commitments while proactively identifying risks and implementing effective mitigation strategies to achieve successful outcomes.

This is a variable-based role in Waltham Abbey, requiring regular travel across multiple operational and delivery sites in line with project needs.

Supporting the North London Reinforcement project with a project office in Waltham Abbey.

About You

What we do isn’t just important – it’s essential. That’s why we look to recruit experts in their field. In this case, we’re looking for someone who:

Demonstrable experience of leading cross functional teams
Demonstrable experience of stakeholder management.
Proficient business writing and communication skills.
Demonstrable experience of problem solving and an appetite for continuous improvement
Good influencing and negotiating skills
A customer-centric approach to delivering a high-quality output
Proven track record in building strong, enduring and effective relationships with key
Good Project Management skills including management of risk for delivery of projects to scope, time, cost, quality, safety and security of supply
Knowledge of business processes and governance.
Working knowledge and application of CDM
Proficient understanding and experience of Safety and Environmental legislation, practices and policies.
Proficient in Contract Management
You have the flexibility to travel when necessary.

What You'll Do

Leadership

Supporting and developing the project managers in your team. There will usually be about five of them, and between one large and a dozen smaller work packages in your portfolio.
Appointing and developing new project managers.
Dealing diplomatically with people. Whether it’s a contract dispute or an underperforming employee, you know how to take the emotion and tension out of a situation and have the ability to help conflicting parties find middle ground.
Committing to developing yourself, in order to develop others. Taking responsibility for building relationships and strong networks and actively creating a diverse, inclusive work environment that allows project managers to flourish.
Driving innovation and encouraging project managers to find new and better ways of doing things. You will keep an open mind and listen to fresh perspectives, especially from employees with backgrounds outside of electricity transmission.

Safety and Wellbeing

Fostering an environment where everyone, regardless of seniority, feels able to share their concerns. As an organisation we are driven by safety. We have an industry leading 'Safe to Say' policy which encourages colleagues to speak up and take ownership of safety issues.
Driving a positive safety culture for project managers and contractors alike. Quickly forming good working relationships with contractors and ensuring they know their safety obligations and can be left to work unsupervised. You will also ensure your project managers are visible on site and contributing to a safe and collaborative team environment.
Ensuring visible and accessible communications are in place throughout the life of a project, such as safety charters and notifications of incidents and lessons learnt. You will also share good practices and good catches, and reinforce positive behaviours.
Making people feel they can talk to you. For example, if there are any safety incidents colleagues know they can speak freely to help you arrive at a clear understanding of events.

Commercial Focus

Reviewing your project managers’ forecasts, including risk forecasts, to ensure they are realistic and reasonable.
Knowing how to adjust, reprioritise, and ask for support from other National Grid departments when you don’t have the resources or assets to match the volume of work.
Having the vision to see where your projects fit in, as part of National Grid as a whole. You can cultivate excellent relationships with other departments and have the insight to appreciate their challenges, and that sometimes their needs will take priority.
Striving to do things as efficiently as possible, mindful that when we bring projects in under budget, we have greater profit to share with our customers.

Contract Management

Using your knowledge of NEC contracts to support the production of those written by your project managers, limiting National Grid’s exposure to risk.
Stepping in when necessary to provide workable solutions during compensation events or contract disputes.
Knowing when it is appropriate to elevate a dispute, and knowing what support to call in.

What You'll Get

A competitive salary between £66,000 - £81,000 - dependent on capability.
A bonus of up to 30% of your salary for stretch performance.
A competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%.
You’ll also be eligible for a Company Car should you meet the Job Requirement criteria.
You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

About Us

The British Energy Security Strategy set out the Government's ambition to connect up to 50GW of offshore generation to the electricity network by 2030. Facilitating this ambition will require significant reinforcements to the onshore electricity transmission network. National Grid Strategic Infrastructure will make this happen.

Here at National Grid, we connect homes and businesses to power, making sure supply and demand match each other. We make sure the lights are on in schools, operating theatres, and sporting arenas; we’re thousands of people working on behalf of millions of people.

Our investment in Strategic Infrastructure via the Great Grid Upgrade will mean more home grown power, greater energy security and a cleaner future.

Whatever your role, wherever you work with us, you’ll help us hit stretching targets and achieve our far‑reaching goal: to secure, clean energy that supports our world far into the future. Here, you will be at the heart of energy.

More Information

This role closes on 3rd September 2026 at 23:59, however we encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible and not wait until the published closing date as this can vary.

We work towards the highest standards in everything we do, including how we support, value and develop our people. Our aim is to encourage and support employees to thrive and be the best they can be. We celebrate the difference people can bring into our organisation, and welcome and encourage applicants with diverse experiences and backgrounds, and offer flexible and tailored support, at home and in the office.

We're committed to building a workforce that represents the communities we serve, and a working environment in which each individual feels valued, respected, fairly treated, and able to reach their full potential.

Please note that in most cases, National Grid is unable to offer sponsorship for employment under the UK points-based immigration system. As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.

Parallel dazu entwickeln wir einen Connected-Growth-Ansatz, um neue Anwendungen, Technologien und Kundensegmente systematisch zu erschliessen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen unternehmerisch denkenden und strategisch starken Global Product & Growth Program Manager
, der Marktanforderungen in nachhaltige Wachstumsinitiativen, innovative Produktstrategien und konkrete Geschäftsmöglichkeiten übersetzt. In dieser globalen Rolle verbindest Du Marktverständnis, Produktmanagement und Geschäftsentwicklung und übernimmst eine zentrale Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Markt, Vertrieb, Engineering und Executive Management.

Aufgaben

Markt- und Segmententwicklung

Aufbau, Pflege und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Markt-, Kunden- und Anwendungswissen
Analyse von Markt-, Kunden-, Technologie- und Wettbewerbstrends
Identifikation neuer Wachstumsfelder, Anwendungen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung globaler Markt- und Segmentstrategien
Übersetzung von Markt- und Kundenanforderungen in Produkt-, Technologie- und Innovations-Roadmaps
Aufbau einer systematischen Markt-, Segment- und Anwendungsdatenbank

Produktstrategie und Produktmanagement

Entwicklung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung globaler Produkt-Roadmaps
Erstellung und Bewertung von Business Cases für neue Produkte, Anwendungen und Technologien
Priorisierung von Produkt- und Entwicklungsinitiativen auf Basis von Marktpotenzial, strategischer Relevanz und Wirtschaftlichkeit
Steuerung des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Markteinführung
Einführung und Weiterentwicklung eines KPI-basierten Produktmanagements

Wachstums- und Programmmanagement

Leitung strategischer Wachstums-, Innovations- und Produktentwicklungsprogramme
Koordination globaler Entwicklungs- und Markteinführungsprojekte
Sicherstellung strukturierter Phase-Gate- und Time-to-Market-Prozesse
Monitoring und Reporting von Wachstumspotenzialen, Opportunity-Pipelines und Realisierungserfolgen
Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung der Unternehmensstrategie sowie der 80/20-Initiativen

Globale Zusammenarbeit und Enablement

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Regional General Managers in EMEA, APAC und Americas
Förderung des Wissenstransfers sowie der Skalierung erfolgreicher Anwendungen zwischen den Regionen
Unterstützung bei der Identifikation, Bewertung und Umsetzung regionaler Marktchancen
Moderation bereichsübergreifender Teams und Initiativen
Förderung einer globalen Wachstums- und Innovationskultur

Profil

Abgeschlossenes Studium in Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Materialwissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (idealerweise 5-10 Jahre) im Produktmanagement, Programmmanagement, Business Development oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion
Erfahrung in technisch anspruchsvollen B2B-Märkten
Erfahrung in internationalen Matrixorganisationen und funktionsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Umsetzung von Wachstums-, Innovations- oder Transformationsinitiativen
Kenntnisse der Fluidtechnik, Dichtungstechnik, industriellen Komponenten oder verwandter Technologien sind von Vorteil
Unternehmerische Denkweise mit ausgeprägtem Markt- und Geschäftsverständnis
Starke analytische und strategische Fähigkeiten
Fähigkeit, Strategien pragmatisch in messbare Ergebnisse zu überführen
Hohe Eigeninitiative und Umsetzungsstärke
Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Moderationsfähigkeiten
Fähigkeit, Menschen und Teams auch ohne direkte Weisungsbefugnis für gemeinsame Ziele zu gewinnen
Hohe Veränderungsbereitschaft sowie Freude an der Gestaltung von Transformationen
Internationale und interkulturelle Kompetenz

Erfolg in der Rolle

Der Erfolg dieser Position wird anhand klar definierter Kennzahlen gemessen:

Umsatzwachstum in definierten Marktsegmenten
Anzahl und Wert erfolgreich umgesetzter Wachstumsinitiativen
Entwicklung und Umsetzung strategischer Produkt-Roadmaps
Verkürzung der Time-to-Market neuer Produkte und Anwendungen
Wachstum der Opportunity-Pipeline und Realisierungsquote identifizierter Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung der Unternehmensstrategie und der 80/20-Initiativen

Warum SFC KOENIG?

Bei der SFC KOENIG gestaltest Du aktiv die Zukunft eines global erfolgreichen Technologieunternehmens. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Markt, Technologie und Strategie und leistest einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Produktportfolios sowie zur Erschliessung neuer Markt- und Anwendungspotenziale weltweit. Es erwartet Dich eine internationale Rolle mit hoher Sichtbarkeit, grossem Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Einfluss auf das zukünftige Wachstum des Unternehmens.

Ausserdem Bieten Wir

Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
Mindestens 25 Ferientage, 5 Brückentage und weitere attraktive Zusatzleistungen
Kostenlose Getränke
REKA-Checks
Gratisparkplätze, zentrale Lage, kostenlose Lademöglichkeit für e-Fahrzeuge
Seit 2002 CO2 neutral
Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein dynamisches Umfeld

jobs.title: Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) Project Manager
jobs.description:
General Responsibilities

Oversee projects related to Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) Exploration. The Project Manager (PM) will oversee utility records review and documentation, and coordinate with survey crews, geophysical teams, and test holes. Geophysical or survey experience is preferred in-order to assist with coordination of primarily QLD through QLB designating activities. The PM will also assist with proposal writing and management. Define survey objectives, design survey approaches, coordinate with subcontractors, owners, clients, and internal teams. Results are incorporated into the planning, design and construction of vital infrastructure such as roads, tunnels, airports, industrial, and other facilities. All SUE projects would be performed in accordance with ASCE 38-22/02.

Essential Roles And Responsibilities

Follow safety rules, guidelines and standards for all projects. Participate in pre-task planning. Report any safety issues or concerns to management.
Be responsible for maintaining quality standards on all projects.
Mid-level SUE PM responsible for oversight of QLD through QLA activities on medium sized projects with a variety of complexity.
Demonstrate knowledge of the SUE processes, procedures, and standards.
Ensure project delivery and compliance with ASCE 38-22 standard.
Participates with more senior staff on large, more complex projects.
Performs site visits, field observations and field data collection or assignments.
Direct and supervise field staff to test and collect data and/or document site activities.
Responsible for developing written proposals to clients for both small and large projects including quality control review of proposals written by others.
Evaluates complex geophysical data and assembles in written reports.
Review final SUE drawing and report.
May serve as team member or lead in meetings and communications with client pertaining to specific projects/tasks.
May oversee work performed by lower level Geophysicists and Technicians.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in geophysics, engineering, surveying or related field.
Minimum 4 years experience with at least 2 years in the SUE field.
Valid driver’s license with acceptable violation history.
Willingness to travel.
Must have one or on track to acquire one of the following licenses in the state of California: Professional Engineer (PE), Professional Geophysicist (PGp), Professional Land Surveyor (PLS)

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Project Manager

Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for planning, monitoring, and controlling project costs to ensure construction projects are delivered within approved budgets. The role involves cost forecasting, budget control, financial reporting, and coordination with project, commercial, and procurement teams to identify risks and improve cost efficiency throughout the project lifecycle.

Duties

Champions “The Layton Way” by delivering predictable outcomes for internal teams, external teams, and customers.
Ensures that “Constructing with Integrity” is delivered by working with honesty, unity, safety, and quality of work.
Helps track and maintain the project budget, cost breakdown structure (CBS), and cost control procedures.
Monitor actual project costs against budgets and identify variances.
Determine whether entitlement exists for a change.
Prepare periodic cost reports, cash flow forecasts, and earned value analyses.
Review and validate subcontractor payment applications and progress claims.
Coordinate with planning/scheduling teams to align cost data with project schedules.
Track commitments, expenditures, and variations/change orders.
Analyze cost trends and recommend corrective actions to prevent cost overruns.
Support contract administration, including claims analysis and change management.
Participate in value engineering and cost optimization initiatives.
Ensure accurate cost records and documentation for audits and project close-out.
Provide cost advice to project management and senior leadership.
Assist in the preparation of final accounts and project financial closeout.
Assist in developing budgets for conceptual and schematic changes

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
Minimum 5 years of construction management experience.
Minimum 2 years of experience in estimating or cost controls within the construction industry.
Proven experience in managing costs for large-scale construction projects (residential, commercial, industrial, or infrastructure).
Strong understanding of all construction documents and how they interface.
Strong knowledge of cost control principles, budgeting, and estimating.
Proficiency in cost control and project management software (e.g., Primavera P6, Procore).
Advanced Excel and financial analysis skills.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and reporting abilities.
Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
High attention to detail and ability to work under pressure.
Knowledge and use of CMiC preferred but not required.

Qualifications

Working closely with our global teams, you will plan and coordinate the execution of complex business needs while simultaneously keeping your team focused on meeting their commitments. Own end to end product development from concept all the way to launch.

Ability to drive development via strategic AI integration, AI-powered automation.

Collaborate closely with Business and Engineering to properly understand the business case and technical constraints.

Work with remote and multi-site teams to deliver related system software components while managing the timelines to match hardware development and launch requirements

Stakeholder Management: Communicate regularly with C-suite on status, risks, and change control

Where needed, improve processes for completeness and better efficiency

Dive deep into the software/hardware technical details of a product and its respective feature KPI

Proactively solve day-to-day challenges and exercise sound judgment

A day in the life

Solving unique development problems with the team while maintaining the timelines to meet business goals.

Leverage AI tool to drive efficiencies.

About The Team

Product devices delivery organization is responsible for end to end Ring/Blink device development from concept to EOL.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of technical product or program management experience
3+ years of software development experience

Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

We are recruiting for a growing technology consultancy delivering complex Microsoft, cloud, infrastructure and cybersecurity services to major organisations in the UK and internationally.

They are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to lead an important global Microsoft 365 transformation programme. The project will involve consolidating multiple Microsoft 365 tenants, companies, user structures, applications and document management environments into one secure and scalable platform. This is a technically complex programme with multiple interconnected workstreams. Identity, devices, applications, data, security and document access will all need to be carefully sequenced to ensure changes made in one area do not create problems elsewhere. You will act as the central point of contact, coordinating senior client stakeholders, architects, consultants, engineers and other subject matter experts. This is not a hands-on engineering role, but you will need enough technical understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and identify risks or dependencies that individual specialists may overlook. You will also need excellent communication and negotiation skills. The programme involves stakeholders across the UK, North America and Asia, so you must be comfortable working across different organisations, cultures and time zones.

The Role You will: Lead the programme from planning through to implementation, transition and closure. Develop and maintain clear plans covering scope, milestones, resources, dependencies, budgets and timescales. Coordinate technical workstreams across Microsoft 365, identity, devices, applications, data, security and document management. Identify cross-workstream dependencies and ensure migrations take place in the correct sequence. Establish strong governance, ownership, reporting and escalation processes. Maintain programme plans, RAID logs, dependency tracking and senior-level reporting. Identify risks, delays and resource constraints early and take corrective action. Challenge assumptions and ensure the wider impact of technical decisions is understood. Lead steering groups, programme meetings, workshops and executive updates. Translate complex technical information into clear business language. Align stakeholders across different companies, priorities and ways of working. Negotiate scope, priorities, resources and delivery dates. Challenge unrealistic expectations in a constructive and commercially aware way. Maintain control of scope, budgets, resources and change requests. Hold internal and external teams accountable for agreed actions and milestones. Ensure the completed programme is successfully transitioned into support or managed services.

Essential Experience To be considered, you will need: Significant experience delivering large and technically complex transformation programmes. Previous responsibility for a major Microsoft 365 migration, tenant consolidation or similar enterprise technology programme. Strong understanding of the Microsoft 365 technology landscape. Experience coordinating multiple interconnected technical workstreams. A good understanding of migration sequencing, integration and technical dependencies. Strong programme governance, planning, risk management and change-control experience. Experience managing scope, budgets, resources and major milestones. Strong client-facing experience with large organisations and senior stakeholders. Experience working with architects, consultants, engineers and technical specialists. Excellent negotiation, influencing and conflict-resolution skills. The confidence to challenge clients and technical teams when required. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

Relevant Technology Experience Your experience is likely to include several of the following: Microsoft 365 tenant migrations and consolidation Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft Intune MDM and MAM Microsoft Defender Power Platform and Power BI Document management systems Modern workplace and endpoint transformation Application and data migrations Cloud or infrastructure transformation You do not need to be an expert in every technology, but you must have enough technical understanding to recognise dependencies, ask informed questions and work credibly with technical specialists.

The Person This role will suit someone who is highly organised, commercially aware and focused on delivery. You will be confident with senior stakeholders, calm under pressure and able to challenge people without becoming abrasive. You may currently work within a large enterprise and feel restricted by a narrowly defined role. Alternatively, you may already work within a consultancy or MSP delivering complex programmes for enterprise clients. What matters most is that you have successfully led major technology migrations and have the technical understanding, judgement and communication skills to take ownership of a critical global programme. Although the immediate priority is this Microsoft 365 consolidation programme, this is intended to be a long-term appointment with further opportunities to lead major transformation projects and help improve how project services are delivered.
